title: Functions in deps re-run the Effect

slides.say: A helper function declared in your component and used in an Effect makes the Effect re-run on every render.
Each render creates a new create options function. Functions are compared by identity, so the dependency always looks changed.
Declare the function inside the Effect instead. Now the Effect only depends on room id.

slides.text: Static helper with no props or state? Move it outside the component.
slides.say: If the function uses no props or state at all, move it outside the component.
